title: 2026 AMC 8 Problem 11
statement: Squares of side length \(1,\) \(1,\) \(2,\) \(3,\) and \(5\) are arranged to form the rectangle shown below. A curve is drawn by inscribing a quarter circle in each square and joining the quarter circles in order, from shortest to longest. What is the length of the curve?

solutions.text: Each piece of the curve is a quarter circle. The radii are \(1,1,2,3,5\), so the total length is \(\frac14\cdot2\pi(1+1+2+3+5)\) \(=\frac{\pi}{2}\cdot12\) \(=6\pi\).
hints: Each arc is one quarter of a circle
Add the radii \(1+1+2+3+5\), then multiply by \(\frac{\pi}{2}\)
